title: Apple Earnings May Raise More Questions
text:
Apple Earnings May Raise More Questions By Ed Ponsi | Jul 31, 2018 | 12:30 PM EDT
I'm an Apple (AAPL) bull. Like many of you, I've been long the stock for years, and I consider it a core position. I'm sure many of us feel a little trepidation as we head into Tuesday's earnings report.
At this time, I have no intention of selling this stock, regardless of what happens after the close today.
